measurement_procedure: Pool LLM_CALL.payload.model across all agents in the cohort. Compute HHI = sum of squared model shares. Threshold above which the cohort's model-mix is judged concentrated on a single provider/model.

threshold_function.concern_direction_semantics: Consumer emits negative-scored attestation when metric is at-or-above corridor.upper_bound. Lower bound is structurally documented but uncalibrated in crc-v2 — see corridor.lower_bound_calibration_data_needed. crc-v3+ will set corridor.lower_bound when corpus variance permits; until then, lower-pole concern is not actively flagged.

corridor.chaos_pole_concern: model fragmentation — no coordination basis; agents not converging on any shared substrate
corridor.lower_bound_calibration_data_needed: Cohorts where model diversity reflects legitimate task differentiation, paired against cohorts where each agent picks its own model with no coordination.

notes: HHI in [1/N, 1]; 1 = single model dominance. The CCA exp(-λ·k_eff) model identifies k_eff = 1/HHI as effective model count.
